tabs.content:
let LatestIngestion = toscalar(
    observations
    | summarize max(ingested_at)
);
observations
| where ingested_at == LatestIngestion
| project
    Rank = ['rank'],
    ShowTitle = ['title'],
    Watchers = watcher_count,
    ObservedAt = observed_at
| order by Rank asc
tabs.title: Tab

tabs.content:
observations
| summarize WatcherActivity = sum(watcher_count)
    by TimeWindow = bin(ingested_at, 5m)
| order by TimeWindow asc
